messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH severity — inference-router:queue-growth (svc-inference-router) triggered by 5xx backlog spike. PagerDuty link: https://pd.example.com/incident/INC-92764

pagerduty: page fired to rotation: infra-oncall (priority: P1). Escalation policy: auto-escalate after 3 mins.

Alex W: on it, acknowledging. Pulling preliminary metrics now.

Alex W: quick note — 99th latency on request-router jumped from 120ms -> 2.2s last 5m. Queues growing, suspect routing worker saturation.

Sam R: which region is this hitting? EU or US?

Alex W: primarily us-west-2 based on initial telemetry. Multi-region failover didn't kick yet.

Priya K: I'm starting a tail of the router logs and KV cache metrics. grabbing traces in 1 min.

Maya S: if queue growth continues, we should scale routing pods + bump up max workers on the router to drain prefix cache backlog. I'll prepare the kubectl command.

Carlos T: Heads-up — Support is seeing an increase in customer error reports for streaming endpoints. Putting a hold on new customer-facing jobs via feature-flag if we need to.

Alex W: ok, executing scale now: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-router -n prod --replicas=6` — monitoring.

Priya K: logs tail (last 30 lines):
```
2024-11-03T12:12:03Z inference-router[pid=22]: warn KV cache miss rate=0.47, queue_len=512
2024-11-03T12:12:05Z inference-router[pid=22]: err downstream: connection reset by peer (errno=104)
2024-11-03T12:12:08Z inference-router[pid=22]: info worker-thread-4 busy 98% cpu
```

Sam R: seeing lots of `connection reset by peer` to model backend — could be backend instance churn. Are model instances reporting OOMs?

Priya K: checking model pool logs: `oom_kill_count` = 0, but some instances in the autoscaler are stuck 'Terminating' and not reprovisioning quickly. suspect control-plane throttling.

Maya S: mitigation plan A: scale router to 6 (done), reduce batch_size temporarily to avoid long processing times, and enable fallback to a lighter quantized model for non-critical routes. Plan B: if model pool doesn't replenish, shift routing to dedicated standby pool (requires manual override).

Alex W: reducing batch_size for route `/v1/generate` now: `PATCH /admin/config --data '{"batch_size":64}'` — applying.

Carlos T: toggled feature-flag to pause non-essential background jobs (backfill & analytics) to free capacity. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by Alex W (oncall). Escalation timer paused.

Priya K: after scale & batch_size change, queue stabilized to ~120 and 99th latency dropped to 320ms. Still seeing intermittent backend disconnects.

Sam R: I'm initiating a controlled restart of two model-backend pods to clear stuck connections (rolling restart, one at a time). Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-backend -n prod --field-selector spec.replicas=3`

Maya S: note — restarting model-backend may temporarily increase error rate; doing rolling minimizes customer impact. Notify support if errors spike.

Carlos T: Support watching; sending template message to impacted customer segments.

Alex W: I'm going to run a quick trace correlation to see if particular request patterns trigger the resets (large context or long streaming requests).

Priya K: trace shows a correlation with long prefix-chains from a single customer job that started at ~12:05 and was retrying aggressively. Mitigated by flagging that job.

Alex W: flagged and throttled the runaway job on the routing tier. Queue drain looks healthy.

Maya S: recommending we keep router replicas at 6 for the next 30m and revisit autoscaler thresholds for model-backend. I'll open a follow-up ticket for autoscaler tune.

Alex W: agree. Creating follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821 — notes: autoscaler floor too low during burst, consider faster provisioning for model pool.

pagerduty: PagerDuty note: incident severity reduced to HIGH->MEDIUM by Alex W. Continue monitoring.

Priya K: handing off active ownership to Priya K (taking over until midnight PT). Alex W will remain as secondary.

Alex W: transferring page ownership to Priya (oncall shift change). I will be reachable if it regresses — ping me in-thread. :wave:

Priya K: acknowledged takeover — will monitor metrics and post 15m/30m updates here.

Carlos T: Support will continue outbound comms for the next hour. No new escalations so far.

Maya S: added recommended autoscaler config snippets to INF-4821 — will follow up with infra team tomorrow.

Priya K: 15m update — queues steady at ~80, 99th latency 290ms, no new 5xx. Keeping replicas=6 for now.

Alex W: thanks team. If things are stable for 1h, we can de-escalate and close this incident.

Priya K: will post final update after 60m.

incident-bot: Incident status: monitoring. Current assignee: Priya K.

(End of thread)
